parameters.query:
-- 1 sola consulta (antes eran 3): upsert del lead + insert del mensaje
-- deduplicado por wamid + reclamo atómico del saludo de bienvenida.
WITH lead AS (
  INSERT INTO public.leads (phone, name, source, temp, status, stage,
                            last_message, last_message_time, welcome_sent_at)
  VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2, ''), 'whatsapp', 'caliente', 'nuevo', 'lead',
          $3, to_timestamp($5::bigint), NOW())
  ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET
    name              = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.name, leads.name),
    -- Solo si es más reciente (Meta puede reintentar o desordenar webhooks).
    last_message      = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.last_message_time >= COALESCE(leads.last_message_time, '-infinity')
                             THEN EXCLUDED.last_message ELSE leads.last_message END,
    last_message_time = GREATEST(leads.last_message_time, EXCLUDED.last_message_time),
    welcome_sent_at   = COALESCE(leads.welcome_sent_at, NOW())
  RETURNING id, welcome_sent_at
), msg AS (
  INSERT INTO public.messages (lead_id, phone, sender, text, time, wa_message_id, msg_type)
  SELECT id, $1, 'cliente', $3, to_timestamp($5::bigint), $4, $6
  FROM lead
  ON CONFLICT (wa_message_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  lead.id                          AS lead_id,
  $1::text                         AS phone,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM msg)       AS mensaje_nuevo,
  -- NOW() es la hora de inicio de ESTA transacción: solo es igual si el
  -- saludo se reclamó en esta misma ejecución (lead nuevo o sin saludo).
  (lead.welcome_sent_at = NOW())   AS enviar_bienvenida
FROM lead;
